cc:Work.dc:title: Early pilots: recorded outcomes with known measurement limitations
cc:Work.dc:description: Report aggregates; P=Proposed, SW=Sliding, V=Vector, U=Utility. First two runs have contradictory success/selection-failure metrics; first Gemini run fails budgeting before valid execution. Gemini v2 lacks current provenance/cost accounting. Do not compare with final Main. Sources: docs/experiments/reports/early-pilot-runs-2026-11-03.md; experiments/results/pilot_offline_20261103_182136/summary.json
